title: SceneAxi credit account and append-only ledger (v1)
description: CreditAccount and CreditLedgerEntry records. A credit account deliberately has NO balance property: a stored balance is a second source of truth that can drift, so the ledger is the only record and the balance is always derived from it. balanceAfter on each entry is a checkable witness of that derivation, not an independent store. Ledger behavior lives in packages/billing; the database enforces append-only in db/migrations.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit timezone. Timezone-less values refuse.

creditAccount.title: CreditAccount
creditAccount.description: One credit account per user. Carries no balance by design.

creditLedgerEntry.title: CreditLedgerEntry
creditLedgerEntry.description: One immutable ledger row. Entries are appended, never edited or removed — enforced in code by the pure append function and in the database by a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger.

sequence.description: 1-based and strictly monotonic per account. Gaps, forks, and reuse all refuse.

movement.description: grant adds (purchase, admin gift), debit subtracts (metered usage), adjustment is an admin correction in either direction.

delta.description: Non-zero credit delta. Sign is fixed by movement: grant is positive, debit is negative, adjustment may be either.

balanceAfter.description: Derived balance witness: previous balance + delta. Never negative — an over-balance debit refuses and appends nothing.

idempotencyKey.description: Namespaced replay key, e.g. stripe-event:evt_1. The same key must never produce a second entry; the same key with a different payload refuses.
